project.title: HighRoads US Cloud Migration

role_overview.summary: HighRoads US is the Boston-based parent operation of the HighRoads enterprise software company, undergoing extensive internal restructuring and headcount right-sizing following the closure of its Canadian offices. Christian served as Cloud Transformation Architect, engaged to complete two final cloud migration workstreams — migrating email infrastructure to Office 365 and Atlassian project management tooling to cloud/SaaS — as part of the organization's broader strategy to eliminate on-premises IT dependencies and reduce operating costs. Both engagements were completed within a compressed three-month window under HIPAA, NIST, and ISO:27001 compliance requirements.

challenge.summary: The client was undergoing extensive internal restructuring, right-sizing staffing and migrating services to the cloud to reduce costs and mitigate risks.

solution.summary: Delivered comprehensive cloud and infrastructure solutions across:

outcomes: ✅ Delivered Exchange Email Cloud Migration engagement
✅ Delivered Atlassian Project Management Cloud Migration engagement
